name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SEO platform with Data API for keywords, backlinks and SERP data, plus Project API for automation.
auth_notes: One API key for Project and Data APIs, sent as an Authorization Token header or an apikey query parameter. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 per its own page.
access_notes: Key is generated in the API Dashboard. Data API calls draw on credits included with paid plans or bought as pay-as-you-go packs. Project API uses subscription limits on every current plan. Practically, API access needs a paid subscription or PAYG purchase.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve key and documented REST API. Data API calls consume paid-plan or PAYG credits, and Project API is capped by subscription limits. Endpoint count covers the Data API table only.
